To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have designed and implemented a novel secure method for signature proxy delegation that provides non-repudiability services to all the involved parties, and that it is suitable for mobile agent applications.

we have developed a new method for signature delegation, that we call Proxy Signature Scheme with Non-repudiation (PSN), and that this method provides confidentiality protection to the secret proxy key and non-repudiable services for the involved parties.

we have developed a new method to delegate signature power to one of several mobile agents, and that we have shown how the method can be used in an agent based paradigm for signature delegation to multiple mobile agents.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the design and analysis of a novel signature delegation method for mobile agents that provides confidentiality protection to the delegated proxy key and provides non-repudiability services to all the involved parties.
the development of a secure method that allows the proxy signer to generate a signature that is indistinguishable from the one that the original signer could have produced.
the problem of how to provide a secure delegation of signature power in a mobile agent-based environment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the method presented in this paper provides the following: (1) confidentiality protection to the delegation key, (2) non-repudiable delegation of signature power, (3) non-repudiability of proxy signature generation, and (4) non-repudicability of receipt of proxy signature.
our method can be applied to a variety of situations in which the delegation of signing power to mobile agents is required.
our proposed scheme is a secure method for signature delegating to mobile agents.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have provided an efficient method to delegate the signature power of a signer to one or more proxy signers that jointly generate a proxy signature on behalf of the signer.
we provide a solution to the following problem: How to securely delegate the signature power to a mobile agent in an untrustworthy remote host.
we have designed an agent-based proxy signature scheme that provides a high degree of security for signature delegation in the presence of mobile agents.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proxy signer does not need to know the original signer's private key, which is the most sensitive information that should be kept private.
it is possible to design a proxy signature scheme in which the proxy signer can be a mobile agent.
the proxy signer is able to delegate its signature power to other parties in a manner that provides non-repudiability of all parties involved in the delegation process.
